title: Edit any PDF on your Mac with this $32 lifetime app
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: PDF Reader Pro is a full PDF editor for Mac, and a lifetime license is $31.99 (reg. $79.99) with code DEAL20.

Preview on your Mac can highlight a PDF and add a signature, but it can’t change the text already on the page. If you want to edit PDFs the way you edit Word documents, try a lifetime license for PDF Reader Pro. With code DEAL20 during the 20% off apps and software sale, $31.99 (reg. $79.99) gets you the Premium license.

Click into any PDF to rewrite text or swap out images. You can merge, split, rotate, crop, or delete pages, and batch tools compress, encrypt, and watermark whole stacks of files at once. OCR turns scanned documents into searchable, editable text, so you won’t retype a scanned contract by hand.

Contracts and paperwork get their own tools. You can build fillable forms with text fields, buttons, and combo boxes, fill out forms made in Adobe Acrobat, and sign with a legally binding digital signature. Redaction blacks out confidential text and images for good, and night mode makes long reading sessions easier on your eyes.

PDF Reader Pro runs on one Mac with macOS 11 or later, and updates are included. This license doesn’t include AI features or PDF to Microsoft Office conversion.

Fix your own PDFs instead of asking someone for a new version.

Through November 15 at 11:59 p.m. PT, use code DEAL20 to get PDF Reader Pro for Mac for $31.99.
